title: Six Thinking Hats — de Bono
problem_statement: Group thinking tangles facts, feelings, and criticism into one argument. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Edward de Bono's Six Thinking Hats (1985): separate thinking modes — white (facts), red (feelings), black (caution), yellow (benefits), green (creativity), blue (process) — worn one at a time.
novelty_assessment: Parallel thinking: everyone thinks the same way at the same time. Novelty check: search prior art for each claimed transfer before investing.
validation_plan: Document the outcome honestly whether it confirms or kills the concept.
